Assets (legacy compatibility only; no preset references them)

Preset IDs
- 0..95: legacy IDs preserved
- 96..191: 96 ABI 2 presets appended

Vector-only guarantee
- 192/192 presets use GC89_DRAW_VECTOR
- 0 preset image IDs
- Stable preset IDs and ABI 2 shape behavior preserved; ABI 3 outline fields added

ABI 3 outline defaults
- outline disabled in all 192 presets
- width 0
- opaque black fallback color
